sourceTitle: Helping teens navigate online news and information
originalTitle: Helping teens navigate online news and information
author: Rachel Huggins

blocks.text: Online spaces are where children and young people discover new ideas, keep up with current events, and learn about the world around them. This is highlighted in Google’s The Future Report, which gathered the views of 6,000 UK teenagers to better understand the opportunities and challenges that technology presents for young people.
blocks.zh: 网络空间是儿童和年轻人发现新想法、了解时事以及认识周围世界的地方。谷歌的《The Future Report》强调了这一点，该报告收集了6000名英国青少年的观点，以更好地了解技术为年轻人带来的机遇和挑战。
blocks.en: Online spaces are where children and young people discover new ideas, keep up with current events, and learn about the world around them. This is highlighted in Google’s The Future Report, which gathered the views of 6,000 UK teenagers to better understand the opportunities and challenges that technology presents for young people.

blocks.text: For many (83%), information comes through algorithm-driven recommendations — which children see as positive for introducing them to new ideas they may not see otherwise. Young people are also increasingly accessing video-based content and prefer this for building understanding, particularly of difficult topics. They are also engaging with AI, using tools like AI chatbots for creativity and learning on a daily basis.
blocks.zh: 对许多人（83%）来说，信息来自算法驱动的推荐——孩子们认为这是积极的，因为这让他们接触到原本可能看不到的新想法。年轻人也越来越多地接触基于视频的内容，并更倾向于通过这种方式来建立理解，尤其是在困难话题上。他们还在使用人工智能，每天借助 AI 聊天机器人等工具进行创造和学习。
blocks.en: For many (83%), information comes through algorithm-driven recommendations — which children see as positive for introducing them to new ideas they may not see otherwise. Young people are also increasingly accessing video-based content and prefer this for building understanding, particularly of difficult topics. They are also engaging with AI, using tools like AI chatbots for creativity and learning on a daily basis.

blocks.text: While the report highlights the positive ways in which the internet is used for discovery and learning, it also points to the challenges young people face in accessing high-quality, trustworthy information. Teens recognised that the proliferation of AI-generated and manipulated content was making the online information environment increasingly complex to navigate. This is echoed in Internet Matters’ own research, which found that the growth of this content is leaving children feeling less trusting of the news they encounter in their feeds and more concerned about their ability to distinguish between what is true and false online.
blocks.zh: 尽管报告强调了互联网在发现和学习方面的积极用途，但它也指出了年轻人在获取高质量、可信信息方面面临的挑战。青少年认识到，人工智能生成和操纵内容的泛滥正在使网络信息环境变得越来越难以驾驭。Internet Matters 自己的研究也印证了这一点，该研究发现，这类内容的增长让孩子们对信息流中遇到的新闻信任度降低，并且更加担心自己辨别网络信息真假的能力。
blocks.en: While the report highlights the positive ways in which the internet is used for discovery and learning, it also points to the challenges young people face in accessing high-quality, trustworthy information. Teens recognised that the proliferation of AI-generated and manipulated content was making the online information environment increasingly complex to navigate. This is echoed in Internet Matters’ own research, which found that the growth of this content is leaving children feeling less trusting of the news they encounter in their feeds and more concerned about their ability to distinguish between what is true and false online.

blocks.text: Addressing these challenges will be essential if we are to preserve the educational benefits of online spaces. Children and young people must have access to high-quality, accurate content, alongside the skills to critically engage in an increasingly complex information environment. This is especially important in the UK, which is set to lower the voting age to 16, with the aim of increasing lifelong democratic participation. However, this will only be possible if young people feel equipped to engage confidently with the news, politics and current affairs they encounter online.
blocks.zh: 若要保留网络空间的教育益处，应对这些挑战至关重要。儿童和年轻人必须能够获取高质量、准确的内容，同时具备在日益复杂的信息环境中进行批判性参与的能力。这一点在英国尤为重要，因为英国计划将投票年龄降低到16岁，旨在提高终身民主参与度。然而，只有当年轻人感到有能力自信地参与他们在网上遇到的新闻、政治和时事时，这一切才有可能实现。
blocks.en: Addressing these challenges will be essential if we are to preserve the educational benefits of online spaces. Children and young people must have access to high-quality, accurate content, alongside the skills to critically engage in an increasingly complex information environment. This is especially important in the UK, which is set to lower the voting age to 16, with the aim of increasing lifelong democratic participation. However, this will only be possible if young people feel equipped to engage confidently with the news, politics and current affairs they encounter online.

blocks.text: Encouragingly, Google’s research found that many teenagers are already using strategies to verify online information, including cross-checking sources (49%), checking the credibility of websites and authors (48%) and speaking to parents and trusted adults about the content they have seen online (45%). However, the responsibility for navigating a changing and complex information environment should not rest with young people alone.
blocks.zh: 令人鼓舞的是，谷歌的研究发现，许多青少年已经在使用各种策略来核实网络信息，包括交叉核对信息来源（49%）、检查网站和作者的可信度（48%），以及与父母和值得信赖的成年人谈论他们在网上看到的内容（45%）。然而，应对不断变化且复杂的信息环境的责任不应只落在年轻人身上。
blocks.en: Encouragingly, Google’s research found that many teenagers are already using strategies to verify online information, including cross-checking sources (49%), checking the credibility of websites and authors (48%) and speaking to parents and trusted adults about the content they have seen online (45%). However, the responsibility for navigating a changing and complex information environment should not rest with young people alone.

blocks.text: Platforms, educators, and policymakers all have a role to play in helping children and young people access trustworthy information and develop digital and media literacy. Schools must be supported with clear direction set by government, alongside the resources and training needed to teach these skills effectively in the classroom. Tech companies also have an important role to play by making their platforms and services safe and media-literate by design. This means supporting children to have age-appropriate experiences and embedding features that help young people evaluate, question and contextualise what they see.
blocks.zh: 平台、教育工作者和政策制定者都可以发挥作用，帮助儿童和年轻人获取可信信息，并培养数字素养和媒介素养。学校必须得到政府明确方向的指导，以及有效在课堂上教授这些技能所需的资源和培训支持。科技公司也应发挥重要作用，让平台和服务在设计上就具备安全性和媒介素养。这意味着支持儿童获得适龄体验，并嵌入有助于年轻人评估、质疑和情境化理解所见内容的功能。
blocks.en: Platforms, educators, and policymakers all have a role to play in helping children and young people access trustworthy information and develop digital and media literacy. Schools must be supported with clear direction set by government, alongside the resources and training needed to teach these skills effectively in the classroom. Tech companies also have an important role to play by making their platforms and services safe and media-literate by design. This means supporting children to have age-appropriate experiences and embedding features that help young people evaluate, question and contextualise what they see.

blocks.text: Parents will also continue to be children’s main source of information about online safety, and who they turn to when they need support. Yet they are also navigating many of the same challenges as their children. As a result, we must ensure that they too feel confident and able to support children — whether this is through building their own media literacy skills, improving access to easy-to-use parental controls or providing advice on where to access high-quality content.
blocks.zh: 父母也将继续是孩子获取网络安全信息的主要来源，也是孩子在需要支持时求助的对象。然而，他们也面临着与孩子相同的许多挑战。因此，我们必须确保他们同样感到自信并有能力支持孩子——无论是通过培养自身的媒介素养技能、改善对易用家长控制工具的获取，还是提供关于在哪里获取高质量内容的建议。
blocks.en: Parents will also continue to be children’s main source of information about online safety, and who they turn to when they need support. Yet they are also navigating many of the same challenges as their children. As a result, we must ensure that they too feel confident and able to support children — whether this is through building their own media literacy skills, improving access to easy-to-use parental controls or providing advice on where to access high-quality content.

blocks.text: Through this shared approach, we can build a safer and more empowering digital environment where every young person can confidently participate and thrive.
blocks.zh: 通过这种共同参与的方式，我们可以构建一个更安全、更能赋予年轻人力量的数字环境，让每个年轻人都能自信地参与并茁壮成长。
blocks.en: Through this shared approach, we can build a safer and more empowering digital environment where every young person can confidently participate and thrive.
